summary: Single-choice dropdown: a button that opens a list of violet-option children. Use when the user picks one value from a short fixed list.

usage.text: The value attribute holds the chosen option's value and the trigger shows that option's label. With no value and no selected option nothing is chosen; the first option is not picked for you.
A value that matches no enabled option is kept: the trigger shows the raw value and the form receives it. Set value only to an existing option's value.
Choosing an option fires input then change, each with detail.value, even when the same option is chosen again. selectValue(value) fires them too; assigning the value property does not.
It opens on click, Enter, Space or the arrow keys, from the open attribute, or with show(); it closes on choice, Escape, an outside press or focus leaving. No event reports opening or closing.
Typing a character on the closed trigger selects the next option whose label starts with it and fires input and change without opening; while open, typing only moves the highlight.

a11y.text: The trigger is named by the label plus the shown value. Without a label its name is only the value or placeholder text.
Opening moves focus into the list, where arrow keys, Home and End move the highlight and Enter or Space chooses. Escape and choosing return focus to the trigger.
The rendered error message is linked to the trigger as its description, after the supporting text.

roles.name: from the label and the shown value
